description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for WebAudioPlayer and its factory within the Rialto media client. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and member variables related to WebAudioPlayer functionality, such as playback control, buffer management, and state notifications.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayer, implementing the creation method with parameters for client, mime type, priority, and configuration.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing IWebAudioPlayer, IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient, and IControlClient, managing Web Audio playback, buffer handling, and state notifications.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayer with client, mime type, priority, configuration, IPC factory, and client controller.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.
